annotations.title: Get my description, services and FAQs

description: Read the signed-in owner's own content for the business the account selects: description (text, highlights and saved_at, or available: false while description editing is off), services (service_id, kind, title, price_display, price_cents, price_kind, section, description, duration_minutes, editable: false for rows from a connected system, shown_to_assistants) and faqs (faq_id, question, answer, source, last_confirmed_at, shown_to_assistants), up to 200 of each. Use the ids with update_service and update_faq. Requires company:read. Read-only.
name: get_owner_content
title: Get my description, services and FAQs
